END GOAL

PHASES
PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 45m "Push Day A"
WARMUP
arm_circles 60 seconds
jumping_jack 2 minutes
inchworm 5 reps
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
push_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
dip 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
tricep_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 45 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pull Day A"
WARMUP
arm_circles 60 seconds
jog_in_place 2 minutes
scapular_retraction 10 reps
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
pull_up 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
chin_up 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
lat_stretch 30 seconds
back_stretch 30 seconds
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 45 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 45m "Legs and Core A"

leg_swings 60 seconds

END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
